entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider functions as a universal layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier L0/L1/L2 loading system. It is an official Hermes provider that supports session archiving with background memory extraction, achieving significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It automatically routes queries between graph, vector, and code retrieval systems to process information from text and code sources.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a knowledge graph to track entity relationships without requiring LLM calls. It supports explicit fact storage with provenance and features a synthesis layer designed for cited prose and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph system capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers byte-level deduplication with connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over the long term. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment options including Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by using background reasoning to update peer representations based on session history. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes wrappers and integrates with frameworks like MCP and Claude Code.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context trees using Git-like version control, including commits, branches, and merges. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms response times via an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Designed as a zero-dependency system for Hermes Agents, this tool requires only pure Python and a SQLite database for sub-millisecond operations. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth while supporting MCP and native tool integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent combines vector search on Qdrant with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context over other data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness improves agent performance on complex tasks by iterating through executions to retain useful lessons and artifacts. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data directly within the filesystem.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise recovery of session details.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local history from over 20 coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across months of past session data. It automatically strips keys and tokens during the indexing process to maintain security while searching gigabytes of historical context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to simplify deployment of the persistence layer.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a human-readable YAML format called engrams to store memory locally for multi-agent systems. It employs hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context while supporting multi-project scoping to separate global, team, and project knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer integrates with Hermes Agent and GitHub to provide portable state across multiple clients. It constructs memory automatically from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents, achieving 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates directly via MCP and specific agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embedding models. It offers a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server, compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and tracking memory contradictions through first-class primitives. It supports an embedded in-process backend, making it suitable for serverless deployments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, integrating with agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, allowing agents to autonomously recall and evolve source-grounded knowledge. It preserves citations and temporal memory without vector databases and supports portable archives for merging data between stores.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs using local-first storage with SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for automated configuration with major coding clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text ranking and graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings during tool search operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across supported platforms like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation for increased transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using stablecoins across multiple chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and reporting artifact usage while automatically generating tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for state updates. It features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory management. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal within the Hermes ecosystem. It utilizes a hybrid search architecture combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while featuring automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit focuses on memory hygiene through a file-based, git-backed directory that manages versioned markdown memories without a database. It enables agents to capture and recall data via slash commands while using specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify and propose diffs for stale or conflicting information.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 through integration with the DeepSeek Harness.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The collection is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is available via CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions, x402 payments, and escrow. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to facilitate secure autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process. It offers rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for varying professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state directly within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,174 human-readable skills distributed as markdown files for native use in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The MIT-licensed repository provides ready-to-paste exports for multiple assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with various environments including OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It enables agents to read bundled resources and execute scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically syncs source edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes to implement the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on an agent's recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides, documentation, and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard to facilitate Hermes Agent adoption within the Brazilian ecosystem.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent discovery and activation for Oracle network interactions. It supports integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite includes eight specialist skills and specific prompting guidelines for FLUX 3 video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry for reusable AI skills provides a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It distinguishes itself by incorporating commerce features through TON payments for skill access.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a YAML-based language with four verbs and a Rust binary. This local-first tool includes a CLI to check, run, and trace task execution across OpenAI and Codex models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill facilitates autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and supports graceful degradation if specific embedding dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to facilitate agent-driven scheduling and habit management. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial code reviews and identify edge cases. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings generated in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project introduces systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates to Hermes Agent workflows. It utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent state management and enforces multi-story task decomposition to prevent early-stop errors.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven tasks.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery capabilities to provide memory between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during session and skill monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding optimized markdown into the README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects specification drift. It monitors official frontmatter specs weekly to ensure skills remain compatible with current runtime profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with clients like Hermes and Cursor. It streamlines the discovery process by providing direct installation commands for identified tools and plugins.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose and gate skill updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators. It operates locally using the Python standard library, requiring no external services or daemons.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The project ensures environment-specific path syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized utilities for Chinese-language workflows, including Douyin video transcription and rule-based removal of common AI writing patterns. It also features macOS-based OCR for structured data extraction and an e-commerce material studio.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational integrity.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for managing bounty boards and buying context, with payments distributed upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides structured web data access across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured briefings that include core conclusions and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers to assess risk and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. Users can manage agents via a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web dashboards. It features container-based isolation, Git worktree management, and persistent sessions via tmux for background execution.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It detects HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid APIs and supports scaling from single VPS agents to orchestrated teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from a single instance to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for technical operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This orchestration tool enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates MCP tools to expand agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and human-in-the-loop verification. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate the review of task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured project implementation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban board.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to battle for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling on consumer GPUs. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and runs via Ollama to eliminate cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A Rust-powered local knowledge graph that pre-indexes code to reduce tool calls and token usage for Hermes Agent. It features auto-syncing on file changes and a browser-based UI for visualizing symbols and callers.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It extracts data from SQLite databases and local session logs to provide a 3D visualization dashboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect API traffic from agents like Hermes Agent and Cursor. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer and redacts authentication headers before recording sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: A real-time widget that monitors token usage, session details, and account limits for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It supports multi-device synchronization to track usage across several machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: A tool for AI-driven UI development that provides layout guidance and design systems via MCP servers. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting general prompting or markdown, including Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer for Hermes Agent that coordinates seven specialized agents. It includes 6 workflows and 36 skills for building and operating apps on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community themes for the Hermes terminal UI. It uses YAML-based configuration to customize ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors with styles such as cyberpunk and retro DOS.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM/GGUF inference.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents featuring identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol and commerce using SOL and USDC on Solana.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It includes a supervisor sidebar for managing conversation threads, checkpoints, and agent approvals.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: A memory integration system featuring session caches and knowledge graphs. It supports chat platforms such as Slack, Telegram, and VS Code, as well as frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup for Hermes Agent using RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It provides automated installation for Linux and macOS along with 40+ skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a complete hermes-agent stack, including 12+ supporting services and 29 community plugins. It offers three scalable deployment tiers ranging from minimum viable setups to production-ready environments with zero cost using free models.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static analysis tool that flags overlapping tool descriptions and inconsistent schemas within AI agent configurations. It performs local, zero-LLM linting for Python 3.10+ environments and supports CI integration through SARIF output.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and maps complex nested authentication structures for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform uses a native plugin to export real-time telemetry from Hermes agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It monitors performance drift against local config baselines using both passive zero-token analysis and scheduled active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue via Hermes Agent, this tool operates as a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces security by requiring explicit approval for all consequential actions and external writes through specialized contract structures.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This local personal assistant adds voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages via Piper and offline operation without API keys. The system features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality for a more natural open-mic experience.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes provides multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for agent data. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and features a built-in circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It supports 24/7 scheduled automation via Cron and offers remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the user experience through guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It includes a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages AI chat sessions across ten integrated communication platforms, including Telegram, Discord, and Slack. It supports visual workflows with approval gates, scheduled jobs, and detailed usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager with an MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes via a side-panel interface. It enables multi-agent group chats and allows users to selectively include or exclude specific browser tabs from the session.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent directly from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage agent chat, scheduled tasks, and server files without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that enables local searching of prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across 15 agents. It tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and API costs without uploading session history or telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for managing sessions and a kanban board for agentic work. It supports the management of profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It utilizes HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface offers real-time log streaming, a file browser, and a task tracking dashboard. It provides management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a self-hosted environment.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on session activity, cost tracking, and the inspection of skill source code. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration settings for Hermes.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
